items.name: Tortugan, the Walking War-Cannon
items.description:
Walking War-Cannon "Tortugan"Level 8 Construct (or Level 6 Animated Object)
Aura faint transmutation; CL 8th
Construction Cost 20,000 gp; Market Price 40,000 gp
Description:
The Walking War-Cannon, colloquially referred to as the "Tortugan," is an ingenious construct designed to act as both a self-mobile artillery piece and a defensive asset. items.description:
Source Inner Sea World Guide pg. 293
Price 30 gp; Weight 25 lbs.
Category Adventuring Gear
DescriptionA cannon ball is the ammunition of a cannon and many other siege firearms. Picking up or drawing a cannon ball requires a move action for Medium and Small creatures, but is a free action for Large and larger creatures.
